messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're seeing a sudden uptick in GPU pod evictions and pending pods in ap-southeast1b since ~02:10 UTC. Eviction pattern looks like small gangs getting bounced and then rescheduled in a tight loop.

devon: I grabbed a few scheduler logs. Looks like the binpacker rejects nodes due to an NVLink topology mismatch: the node reports NVLink groups that don't match the model's placement constraint, so the scheduler treats them as incompatible.

kai: Can you paste the exact error?

devon: Sure, snippet from kube-scheduler logs: `node "gk1-rack-17": incompatible gpu-topology: expected groups [[0,1],[2,3]] got [[0],[1,2,3]] -> rejecting for gang size 2`

lina: That explains the fragmentation. Pods that request gang-affinity=nvlink are being filtered out, so they spill to other nodes and trigger preempts.

maria: Impact: ~120 pod restarts in the last 20m, some jobs timed out and retried — cost bump noticed on the billing dashboard. Estimate ~3-4 GPU hours wasted so far. :disappointed:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-412 (severity: P2) — linked resources: ap-southeast1b GPU pool.

kai: Is this a node-level BIOS/driver mismatch or a labeling/survey issue? We recently rolled a CUDA/driver update to some racks yesterday.

devon: Nodes that got updated report nvlink topology via `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` differently. Older nodes still report groups as pairs. Newer images flatten the reporting in nvml for some instance types.

lina: So scheduler's matching logic is brittle to different topo representations. We should fallback to 'has NVLink connectivity' boolean rather than exact grouping for gang placement when gang size <= available contiguous GPUs.

maria: Short-term mitigation: can we relax the pod's topology constraint or add a scheduler predicate override to allow mixed-topo placements until we fix the detection?

kai: I can push a canary change to the scheduler policy to treat topology mismatches as soft-affinity for 1 hour in ap-southeast1b. Will monitor evictions.

devon: Patch snippet I'll use in scheduler policy: `predicates: - name: NVLinkTopologyStrictMatch mode: soft-fallback` (will add logging).

maria: Also please cordon any fully-updated racks if their nvml reports are incompatible — we don't want to widen blast radius. Marking `gk1-rack-17` and `gk1-rack-18` cordoned for placement.

ops-bot: `kubectl cordon gk1-rack-17` executed by kai.

lina: Long-term: runtime should normalize NVML topology output into a canonical adjacency graph before the scheduler. Filed infra-ticket INFRA-1357 to normalize across images + add unit tests.

maria: Good. Kai, proceed with the soft-fallback canary and update this thread with telemetry (eviction count, pending pods, cost delta). If we don't see improvement in 30m, revert and try relaxing pod constraints.

kai: On it. Will post metrics in 10m. :thumbsup:
